Multi-originator funnel-in and pass-through signals fired, but the activity is affirmatively explained: the inbound legs reconcile to the declared catering business; the recurring outbound to Riverside Linen Supply Ltd. is consistent with history; the source of funds is established; and the period volume fits the anticipated profile (roughly 43,500 dollars against roughly 44,000 dollars expected). The sanctions and internal caution-list screen is clean, and a common-name inbound counterparty, John Calderon, was a near-match to a watchlist entry but was considered and excluded on the absence of any shared identifier. No predicate risk is nameable.
